violations.text: The chlorine sanitizer concentration for the sanitizing cycle of the dishwasher was 0 parts per million (ppm). Chlorine sanitizing solutions must be between 50-100 ppm. 3-bay sink is to be used until dishwasher is serviced and reaching proper sanitizing concentration. New Violation. Correct By: 06/25/2026

2-door reach-in #2 was observed held at 51 degrees Fahrenheit. Coleslaw observed at 51 degrees F. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. TCS foods that were made this morning were moved to properly functioning units. TCS foods made prior to today were voluntarily disposed of during inspection. No TCS foods are to be stored in this unit until it is maintaining a consistent temperature at/below 41 degrees F. New Violation. Correct By: 06/25/2026
The non-food contact surfaces of the walk-in condenser fan guards have an accumulation of dust, dirt, black residue, and other debris. New Violation. Correct By: 05/04/2026

The floor and wall junctures behind the mop sink do not have coving. The floor and wall junctures must be coved and closed to no larger than 1/32nd of an inch. New Violation. Correct By: 05/04/2026
